title: CruxModel
description: Contract of the semantic model emitted by the parser. The UI and every other client depend only on this contract.

machines.description: State machines (orthogonal regions) of this Core — one per state enum, statechart style.

events.description: Documentation authored on the Core's event enum variants, for events that appear in this Core's transitions. Only documented events are listed (the transition tables already enumerate the vocabulary), so an undocumented app emits exactly the JSON it emitted before this field existed.

effects.description: Same as `events`, for effects — keyed by the label transitions use (`AudioOperation::Start`, `Render`).

name.description: The identifier as transitions reference it. Data from the analyzed application — never translated.

doc.description: Documentation authored on it in the analyzed source (`///`, annotation lines removed). Author prose — never translated.

name.description: Name of the state machine (usually the state enum's name).

doc.description: Documentation authored on the state enum itself (`///` in the analyzed source), with annotation lines removed. Absent when the source carries none. Author prose read out of the analyzed application — never translated.

markers.description: Markers declared on the state enum; they describe the whole region.

tags.description: Free-form tag names declared on the state enum with `@tag <name>`.

states.description: Leaf states of the machine, in declaration order. Children of composite (hierarchical) states are encoded as `Parent/Child` paths.

state.description: A declared leaf state. A bare string is the state's name; the object form adds the documentation authored on it in the analyzed source. A producer emits the bare form whenever there is no documentation, so a model of an unannotated application is identical to a pre-documentation one.

name.description: Leaf state name; `Parent/Child` for a composite state's child.

doc.description: Documentation authored on the enum variant (`///`), with annotation lines removed. Author prose from the analyzed application — copied verbatim, never translated.

tags.description: Free-form tag names declared with `@tag <name>`. Identifiers from the analyzed application — never translated.

marker.description: A semantic marker declared in the analyzed source, as an `@` line inside a `///` doc comment. Declared evidence, not inference — which is why `initial` and `final` are deliberately absent: those are derived from graph shape and `#[default]`. A stable identifier, never prose: clients render their own localized label for it, and a client that meets an unknown value should ignore it rather than reject the model.

from.description: Source state, or "*" meaning any state.

to.description: Target state, or "*" when the target is decided at runtime (e.g. carried by the event payload).

effects.description: Effects requested when this transition fires (e.g. "Render", "AudioOperation::Start").
